title: Very nice
text: Very nice. You need to attach the post and base to the fan itself. Easy to do. Follow the directions and be aware of the notches you have to line up. There are about 12 screws included. Its quiet. The only complaint is the remote. It works well but its extremely hard to push the buttons for all functions! I like this fan so well that I purchased it for my bedroom. It creates white noise. That's a nice surprise feature.

product_metadata.title: Lasko 2505 Portable Electric 36”Oscillating Tower Fan with Fresh Air Ionizer, Timer and Remote Control for Indoor, Bedroom and Home Office Use, 36 Inch, Black
features: BEAT THE HEAT –If you live in the heat with no central air, or your window AC units do a poor job of moving air around your whole house or apartment, this stand up fan creates excellent air flow making you feel cooler. Comes with built-in carry handle, optional oscillation and a handy remote for when you don’t feel like getting up to change the settings.

VERY QUIET – Powered by 3 speed settings H/M/L, fan creates a powerful breeze, but even on H, you can still hear the TV. If you need white noise to sleep, this fan is tall enough to aim over a high bed and creates a soothing purr that drowns out bedroom noises making it easy to fall asleep. Energy efficient timer can be set up to 7 hours.

FRESHER AIR – The built-in Ionizer disperses millions of negative ions into the air that bond with positively charged ions which includes things like dust, bacteria, pollen, smoke and other allergens. Once the bond is formed, the particles become heavier and fall to the ground. As the negative ion levels grow in the room, the air feels naturally fresher.

A REAL SPACE SAVER – Standing 36” tall with a small 12” x 12” footprint, the sleek, vertical design optimizes floor space letting you to put the tower fan in places where pedestal & box fans won’t fit, without sacrificing air circulation, comfort or style. Ideal for the dorm, kitchen, living room, RV and home office.

TRUSTED FOR GENERATIONS – Lasko has been making quality household products for over 100 years. Lasko tower fans are ETL Listed and come with our patented Blue Plug safety fuse technology making them a safe choice for a cooling fresh air breeze when it’s hot and humid outdoors.
description: The Lasko 2505 Tower Fan is 36” tall with a black body. The sturdy plastic base assembles easily with a phillips-head screwdriver, and occupies a 12” x 12” footprint on your floor. This sleek, vertical space saving design allows you to put the fan in small places, where other fans won’t fit without sacrificing air circulation, style or comfort. Powered by 3 quiet speed settings, this fan helps you beat the heat. The fan delivers excellent air flow but is still quiet enough to hear the TV – even on HIGH. The fan creates just the right amount of white noise making it ideal for sleeping at night when it’s warm and stuffy. Tall enough to aim over a high bed and powerful enough to reach across the room. If you live in the heat with no central air, or your window units do a poor job of moving air around your home or apartment, this fan creates excellent air flow and will help make you feel cooler. The fan is lightweight, portable and easy to operate. It comes with remote control, optional oscillation, programmable timer and a built-in Ionizer to help freshen the air in your room. The Ionizer disperses millions of negative ions into the air that bond with positively charged ions which include things like dust, bacteria, pollen, smoke and other allergens. Once the bond is formed, the particles become heavier and fall to the ground thus the air feels naturally fresher. Lasko has been making quality household products for over 100 years. Lasko tower fans are ETL Listed and come with our patented Blue Plug safety fuse technology making them a safe choice for a cooling fresh air breeze when it’s hot and humid outdoors.
